title: LiveAgentStreamPublish
description: live.agent-stream-publish@1 (the Agent Streams plan, S1): the publish part of the answer to POST /api/streams/agent (beside the stream, live.agent-stream@1). WHIP_URL is where the desk publishes, TICKET is the publish ticket (wpt_ plus 32 random bytes, base64url; Live keeps only its sha256, it is bound to this stream, this person and one WHIP session, and it lives four hours), and EXPIRES_AT is when the ticket dies. The desk sends the ticket as Authorization: Bearer wpt_… on POST /whip/agent/:id. A ticket that does not match, has expired or names another stream answers 401 invalid_ticket; a second WHIP session while one is up answers 409 already_publishing. POST /api/streams/agent/:id/ticket renews the ticket (the desk renews at three hours) and DELETE /api/streams/agent/:id/ticket revokes it: that is the kill switch, and Live ends the WHIP session at once.

ticket.description: The publish ticket, shown once. Live stores only its sha256.
